ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A student designed an experiment to study the behavior of earthworms: she prepared a large 1-square-meter tray filled with soil and divided it into four quadrants, with different conditions set in each quadrant. She placed 20 earthworms in the tray, initially 5 in each quadrant. After 20 minutes, it was found that all 20 earthworms had gathered in the high-temperature, low-humidity quadrant. What kind of behavior of earthworms did this experiment show?

Apply the behavior definitions: the worms’ distribution changed according to environmental condition intensity, not because a directional signal guided them along a path.
